create_resource_monitoring_thread: create a ResourceMonitoringThread to monitor a process PID for CPU and IO stats at a set interval
start_resource_monitoring: start a ResourceMonitoringThread to collect resource stats samples for a given process PID
stop_resource_monitoring: stop a running ResourceMonitoringThread by calling its stop method to halt sampling
create_resource_stats_sample: create a ResourceStatsSample dataclass to hold CPU, IO, and thread metrics for a process
review_compress_cpu_affinity: review the compress_cpu_affinity helper that converts a CPU affinity list into a compressed range string
